operations.outcome: Conditional partial pass. The residual occurrence diagram has a natural dual cap and, under an explicitly supplied segmentwise marking plus staggered target lattice, a unique strict map H↦-x3 f+ whose first Cartier symbol becomes -f+ after conormal evaluation. The full geometric comparison remains open: ordinary uniform associated grade is zero, Hom_R(R/(x3),R)=0 blocks a strict free-target shortcut, and existing D03 labels do not derive the segmentwise marking.
